pages.text: Leonard's Wand stores a splash potion as eight repeatable shots. Its original three-dimensional model and texture are restored. It has 128 durability, cannot be repaired, and rejects ordinary table and book enchantments. A spawned Leonard now drops this wand. Conjure Leonard now provides ritual access.

Combine exactly one wand and one Splash Potion, shapelessly, in a two-by-two or larger crafting grid. This replaces the stored effects and sets eight shots; it does not add to existing charges. Drinkable and lingering potions do not work. There is no returned bottle or extra wand.

Charging copies the splash potion's base and custom effects, including duration and amplifier. A splash with no effects still charges the wand with empty-effect shots. Potion base identity is not retained: this reproduces the legacy effect-copying behavior rather than special water-potion interactions.

Right-click with a charged wand to fire a vanilla splash projectile with those effects. Each successfully inserted shot spends one charge, one durability and a ten-tick cooldown. The projectile travels with the original speed one, inaccuracy one and minus-twenty-degree pitch offset. Vanilla splash impact rules determine affected targets.

The stored effects determine the projectile color; custom potion color overrides are not copied. Charges, names and other wand data are not copied into the projectile. The tooltip shows remaining shots, and only a charged wand glints. An empty wand does not fire merely because it is named or damaged.

Recharging and the final shot preserve durability damage, custom names and unrelated item data. The last shot clears only potion-related data. This prevents a port-specific free-repair bug because modern durability is stored in item NBT. Creative players still spend charges, while ordinary creative durability rules apply.

Placed on an altar, the wand adds 99 capacity in the wand category, from the legacy 64 times 1.56 value. It is currently available through the creative tab or /give @s bewitchment:leonards_wand. The charging recipe does not create an uncharged wand from raw materials.
